overloads.semanticRole: The SET DATABASE PARAMETER command allows you to modify various internal parameters of the 4D database.

discriminatedBy.rule: value's accepted range/type is selected by which DatabaseParameterSelector constant is passed; some selectors expect a sub-enum value (see that selector's description), others a plain Real/Integer or Text setting.

constraints: If aTable is omitted, the command applies to the default table.

selector must be one of the DatabaseParameterSelector enum constants; the meaning, scope, and valid values of the value parameter depend entirely on which selector constant is passed (several selectors -- Direct2D status, Diagnostic log level, Min TLS version, Times inside objects, Dates inside objects -- draw value from their own dedicated sub-enum; see each DatabaseParameterSelector entry's description).
